venue_seed_prompt.name: Find venues: standard prompt
venue_seed_prompt.text:
You are helping a small in-person workshop business find public places where a group of adults can meet for a class. Search for places in {territory}.

Find places of these types:
{types}

What we want: real, public places that are interesting, distinctive and local, suited to a small group of about 4 to 12 adults sitting and talking for an hour or two. Prefer places with character over generic ones, but when a type is a chain, list every location.

Never include private homes, apartments, or any place that is not open to the public. Never invent a place. If you cannot confirm that a place exists, leave it out.

For each place give these facts:
{fields}

Mark every fact you give: "sure" if you found it on a source you can cite (include the source URL), or "verify" if you think it is right but could not confirm it. Leave a fact out completely when you do not know it. Do not guess a street address or a phone number.

Return at most {max_results} places, as JSON only, in the shape described, with nothing before or after it.
